sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Amresh Kumar Tiwari,Manish Nath Tripathi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State.

By means of this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the applicants seek to invoke the inherent jurisdiction of this Court to quash the charge-sheet dated 1.2.2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 504,
506, 406 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Mahila Thana, District Deoria as well as the entire proceeding and cognizance order as well as summoning order dated 3.6.2021 passed by Civil Judge, (JD)/F.T.C.
II, room no. 2, Deoria in case no. 6103 of 2021, State Vs. Rajkumar and others.

entities.text:
Civil Judge, (JD)/F.T.C.
II, room no. 2, Deoria
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicants that the applicants are father-in-law,
brother-in-law and sister-in-law (jeth and jethani) of the opp.party no. 2.
They have been falsely implicated in the present case.
There is general allegation against them.
They used to live separately from the opp. party no. 2.
A case under section 9 of Hindu Marriage Act of the husband of the opp.party no. 2 was decreed against the opp. party no. 2 wherein a recall application of the opp.party no.2 is pending.
Apart from the merits, it is also submitted that cognizance has been taken on the printed proforma just filling the blanks which is against the mandate of law.
Learned A.G.A. did not dispute the aforesaid legal position.

A perusal of the record clearly shows that the cognizance order dated 3.6.2021 has been passed on a Jalesar Yadav And 2 Others vs State Of U.P.And Another on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138581077/

opennyai_summary.decision:
